On my last day at work, not only did my manager not say goodbye, our last conversation was filled with tension. I don't have any attachment to this company anymore but it still left a bad taste in my mouth.
</message>
output: You have been shown how little some people value the good, and how easily they can overlook the bonds of common humanity. Let this be a lesson in the nature of others, not a wound to your own character. Remember that you cannot control their actions, only your own response to them. Walk away with a clear conscience, for it is not the departure that matters, but the manner in which you depart.
